title: Rustryx
description: Golden signals, SLO, upstream, blob store, PostgreSQL pool, jobs, authentication and runtime of Rustryx nodes.

panels.title: Availability 5m
panels.description: Share of requests without 5xx. Probe and metrics routes excluded.

panels.title: Error budget remaining (30d)
panels.description: Share of the 0.1% error budget left in the rolling 30 days. Negative means the 99.9% objective is missed.

panels.title: PostgreSQL up
panels.description: 0 means /readyz is 503 on that node: SELECT 1 does not answer within 1 s.

panels.title: p95 metadata
panels.description: Objective: below 300 ms.

panels.title: p95 TTFB cache hit
panels.description: Objective: below 150 ms.

panels.title: p95 latency by class
panels.description: Time to response headers. For a streamed download this is the time to first byte.

panels.title: Shed requests (429 and 503 from own backpressure)
panels.description: Rare event: shown as increase per interval, not as a rate.

panels.title: Burn rate (1 = budget lasts exactly 30 days)
panels.description: Pages at 14.4 on 5m and 1h together; warns at 6 on 30m and 6h.

panels.title: Upstream errors by kind
panels.description: timeout, connect, 5xx and circuit_open. Rare events: increase per interval.

panels.title: Circuit breaker state
panels.description: Per proxy repository. Non-zero means the breaker is not closed.

panels.title: Errors (S3 or disk)
panels.description: Rare event: increase per interval.

panels.title: Local store free space
panels.description: Alerts at 15% (high) and 5% (critical). Writes are rejected below 10%.

panels.title: DB pool waits
panels.description: Requests that had to wait for a connection. Non-zero with zero idle connections alerts.

panels.title: Redis up and request results
panels.description: Redis never influences /readyz. A missing series means Redis is not enabled.

panels.title: Seconds since last success
panels.description: A probe cannot see a job that is alive but stuck; this panel and RustryxJobStale can.

panels.title: Job runs by result
panels.description: Rare event: increase per interval.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: 1 while a job holds its lock and runs.

panels.title: Lock acquisitions and losses
panels.description: Any lost lock alerts. Rare event: increase per interval.

panels.title: Attempts by method and result
panels.description: Rare events: increase per interval. A spike of denied is an alert.

panels.title: JWKS age
panels.description: Alerts above one hour. Tokens keep validating against the last good key set.

panels.title: Break-glass logins
panels.description: Every use alerts and is in the audit log.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second (cores).

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: Uploads are streamed: growth with traffic is a leak, not a feature.
